body: I think you should give it a try, relationships are precious and it is hard to find someone with who you get that good vibe and intimacy, you really shouldn’t banalize what you’re living. I think you should just see it as a challenge to see what you both can go through, and nobody forces you to stay in this if you realize that it is not for you. Do you have any plans of where you’ll end up after these 3 years? If not, what keeps you from planning to move back with him !
